source: Creatures used by the skill formula vectors (built by StatVectors, like formulas_creatures.json) plus variants with extra stat functions, traits and invulnerabilities; config values the skill formulas read
note: Each creature: base (the creature of formulas_creatures.json it is built from, or itself), mods (applied after the build; syntax: add:STAT:v = FuncAdd order 0x40, mul:STAT:v = FuncMul order 0x30, atk_trait:TRAIT:v / def_trait:TRAIT:v = the trait value set with count 1, invul:TRAIT = trait invulnerability count 1), input (what StatVectors builds), expected (user_info/raw as in the stats files), skill_probes (calcStat(STAT, init) for the stats the skill formulas read, key 'stat@init'), traits (attack/defence: TRAIT -> [value, count] for every trait that is not at its default 1.0 / count 0; invul: list), elements (attack_power / defence_value by element index 0 fire, 1 water, 2 wind, 3 earth, 4 holy, 5 dark, via getAttackElementValue / getDefenseElementValue; attack_element = getAttackElement()), flags.
